title: Regions: ConditioningSetArea and ConditioningSetMask
hook: A boxed prompt is a real crop: the model sees only that part of the latent. A mask is a share of the blend, with the model looking at everything. Strength is relative, and bare cells get nothing.

verified.claim: Area crops the latent the model sees, and the fade over up to 8 cells is applied only on sides that do not touch the picture's edge.
verified.ref: get_area_and_mult compared with the lab's port on four areas, on a CPU

verified.claim: Each cell is the sum of answer times weight, divided by the sum of weights. A cell with no entries gets zero.
ConditioningSetArea divides pixels by 8 whatever the model, and the percentage node uses the real latent size.
A boxed positive gets a same-area copy of the negative.

A mask is resized to latent size with bilinear filtering, and mask bounds sets an area from its box. On a CPU a square mask gave area (32, 32, 25, 32) and a model input of 32 by 32 cells, with no enlarging.
The flux_regional picture's data says: lighthouse prompt on the left half, forest on the right, FLUX.1 schnell, cfg 1, 8 steps, made with RES4LYF's ClownRegionalConditioning2.
